hmek001.name: Titan Hammer
hmek001.description: A frontline juggernaut armed with immense firepower and reinforced armor plating.
hmek001.appearance: A two-legged heavyweight frame with oversized actuator drums and layered chest armor. Steel-gray plating with black trim wraps reinforced manipulator assemblies.

hmek002.name: Dread Bastion
hmek002.description: A fortress on legs, designed to absorb immense damage while controlling the battlefield.
hmek002.appearance: A four-legged fortress chassis with thick limb casings and a high-volume central hull. Matte obsidian armor is marked with red caution bands around reinforced hardpoint rings.

hmek003.name: Thunder Colossus
hmek003.description: A walking artillery platform capable of unleashing devastating long-range barrages.
hmek003.appearance: A four-legged bombardment frame with a broad armored deck and stacked long-gun mounts. Dark gray industrial plating is segmented by yellow service stencils and gantry rails.

hmek004.name: Goliath Enforcer
hmek004.description: An elite suppression unit, built for enduring engagements and area control.
hmek004.appearance: A four-legged suppression frame with reinforced hip blocks and a broad command torso. Steel-gray plate stacks with red combat bands cover clustered weapon sockets.

hmek005.name: Onyx Warlord
hmek005.description: A relentless war machine, engineered for brutal assaults and frontline dominance.
hmek005.appearance: A two-legged assault body carrying four reinforced arms around a deep chest cavity. Gloss-black armor with crimson seam lights creates a hard-edged, plated profile.

hmek006.name: Hellstorm Titan
hmek006.description: A walking inferno, equipped with flame-based weaponry for area-wide destruction.
hmek006.appearance: A four-legged incendiary platform with a reinforced spine and integrated burner housings. Red-orange armor shells are perforated by thermal louvers and exhaust chimneys.

hmek007.name: Crimson Juggernaut
hmek007.description: A terrifying siege unit designed to break enemy lines with overwhelming force.
hmek007.appearance: A four-legged breach chassis with thick crimson slab armor and overbuilt joint collars. Black interlock panels frame heavy mount pylons and structural braces.

hmek008.name: Vanguard Behemoth
hmek008.description: A defensive stronghold, built to withstand relentless attacks and outlast any opponent.
hmek008.appearance: A four-legged bastion platform with a low, wide hull and layered anti-impact plating. Steel-gray armor carries red identification marks around recessed defensive ports.

hmek009.name: Storm Leviathan
hmek009.description: A towering battlefield menace, combining energy-based offense with unmatched resilience.
hmek009.appearance: A four-legged energy frame with a tall superstructure and side-mounted array housings. Reinforced plate belts surround luminous conduit spines and shield manifolds.

hmek010.name: Iron Tyrant
hmek010.description: A walking war fortress, capable of crushing enemies with relentless firepower and impenetrable armor.
hmek010.appearance: A four-legged warframe with a massive armored trunk and stacked mount architecture. Dense plate layers and thick actuator housings give it a rigid fortress silhouette.
